about: sources: one row per fetch source, status FETCHED or NOT FETCHED with the reason; series lists the series files built from it. series: one row per series file with the citation fields of the exact raw files behind it (publisher, title, URL, vintage, period, retrieval date, sha256, cadence, next release). The SBA FOIA definitions, including the seasoned charge-off cohorts, are in definitions.

definitions.approved: Every approval row in the files, including loans later cancelled.
definitions.cancelled: Loans with status CANCLD (cancelled; never disbursed). They are out of loans, volume and every charge-off denominator, and are reported so the exclusion can be seen.
definitions.chgoff_amt: Sum of GrossChargeOffAmount over CHGOFF loans (7(a): guaranteed and unguaranteed portion; 504: SBA/CDC balance).
definitions.chgoff_amt_rate: Same cohorts: sum of GrossChargeOffAmount / sum of GrossApproval of disbursed loans.
definitions.chgoff_n: Loans with status CHGOFF, by approval fiscal year (a cohort count, not charge-offs dated in that year).
definitions.chgoff_rate: Seasoned cohorts only: approval FY2011 to FY2020 pooled, each at least five full fiscal years old at the as-of date. Rate = sum of charged-off loans / sum of disbursed loans over those cohorts. Cancelled and undisbursed loans never enter the denominator. A denominator under 30 is flagged.
definitions.class: A loan belongs to every class whose NAICS code list (any edition, see naics-map.json) contains its NaicsCode. Loans with a blank NaicsCode belong to no class but count in "all". Before FY2001 the blanks fall on whole industries, so class figures for those years, and for the window "all", undercount and are refused by the renderer unless flagged.
definitions.disbursed: Loans with a disbursed status: paid in full, charged off, active (EXEMPT), and 504 CLOSED. The denominator of the charge-off rate.
definitions.geography: us = every row in the files (all states and territories). A state is the loan's ProjectState. A site market sums the loans whose (ProjectState, ProjectCounty) strings are listed in its composition (geographies.json).
definitions.loans: Approvals net of cancellations: every loan in the FOIA files whose LoanStatus is not cancelled (CANCLD). Undisbursed loans (7(a) COMMIT, 504 NOT FUNDED) are included because they are live approvals.
definitions.volume: Sum of GrossApproval over the same loans. 7(a): total loan amount; 504: SBA/CDC (debenture) loan amount, not the whole project.
